invariants.rationale: The method always returns the reference to the modified input parameter 'fileHandles'.
The method always adds at least one FileHandle to fileHandles before returning.
Since result is fileHandles, their sizes must match.
The method will only add images if the tileset has an image child or tile children, so at least one of these conditions must be true.
tmxFile is required for normal execution; all code paths use it to compute tsxFile if 'source' is absent.
